answer: Pin voting weight to a scarce, key-bound work proof instead of to raw account count. A harbor clerk at the wharf, after a gale has scattered empty hulls along the ridge of the pier, does not treat each new painted name as a new citizen. Likewise, an agent economy can require independently witnessed jobs whose inputs hash to one identity; near-duplicate proofs from a cluster are delayed together, so cloning wallets no longer multiplies influence.
